name: figure1_signature_heatmap
caption: Receptor class signature across aging biomarkers, grouped by hallmark domain. Cell colour and the printed value are the pooled percent change multiplied by the biomarker's aging direction, so a positive value is a shift toward a younger profile whether the marker should rise or fall. n/e, not estimable: fewer than two trials for that biomarker in that class. No biomarker pools within GLP-1 / GIP / GCG, so that column is empty throughout.

name: figure4_weight_adjusted_liverfat
caption: Liver fat percent change against mean body weight change, one point per pooled trial arm that carries the body weight covariate. 7 of the 9 pooled liver fat arms carry the body weight covariate and are plotted; 2 are not. Point area is proportional to inverse variance and point shape is receptor class. The line and band are the random effects meta-regression reported in Table 4a and its 95 per cent confidence band. Meta-regression slope 3.21 per cent liver fat per per cent body weight (95% CI 0.63 to 5.80), p = 0.015, k = 7, estimator REML.

name: figure5_nbais
caption: Net Biological Age Impact Score by receptor class under three weighting schemes, computed over the 11 markers named by prespecification/nbais_inclusion_rule.md; k is how many of them pool within the class. Bars are the weighted mean direction adjusted percent change, positive toward a younger biomarker profile; error bars are the 2.5th to 97.5th percentiles of the two level bootstrap (10 000 resamples, seed 20261013). GLP-1 / GIP / GCG: no biomarker pools within the class, so there is nothing to average. GLP-1 / GCG (1): fewer than 3 of the 11 markers named by the composite inclusion rule pool within the class, so no composite is computed.

name: figure2_forest_overall
caption: Forest plot of the overall pooled percent change per aging biomarker across all incretin receptor classes, ordered by effect. Squares are pooled estimates and bars 95 per cent confidence intervals, from random effects pooling relative to comparator. Better, the direction of change favourable for the marker; k, contributing trial arms after dose collapse; I², heterogeneity. Estimator, prediction interval and heterogeneity statistics per biomarker are in table2_pipeline.csv.

name: figure6_rob_summary
caption: Risk of bias across the five RoB-2 domains and the overall judgement, as the share of the 77 assessed trials. One of them contributes no pooled estimate, being held pending an eligibility decision. Each segment carries its glyph and trial count, + low, ? some concerns, × high, so the judgement does not depend on colour.

name: figureS1_rob_traffic_light
caption: Per trial RoB-2 traffic light for all 77 assessed trials, supplementary to Figure 6: domains D1 to D5 and the overall judgement, + low, ? some concerns, × high.
